howto.title: How to use RoomsCode
howto.intro: RoomsCode is a platform for live programming classes and presentations. The Host shares their screen and the code open in VS Code; viewers follow everything in real time and chat — without being able to edit anything.
howto.host_t1_text: On the home screen, click Host, enter your name and click Create room. You get a 6-character code, shown in the top bar (click it to copy).
howto.host_t1_1_text: Give the code to your viewers, or use the share button next to it to copy an invite link: anyone who opens the link arrives with the code already filled in.
howto.host_t2_text: Once the room is created, you can share your screen, your VS Code code or both, and keep track of who is watching.
howto.host_t2_1_text: Click Share screen and choose what to show. To finish, click Stop sharing.
howto.host_t2_2_text: Install the extension (Download extension button on the home screen). In VS Code, click RoomsCode in the status bar and paste the code copied with Copy extension code — never share that code with viewers. Your open tabs then appear for the class, with your cursor's line highlighted.
howto.host_t2_3_text: Click a viewer's name to open the menu. The chat bubble restricts their chat (click again to allow it): they can no longer send messages, mentions or line quotes, but can still copy and download the code. The kick removes them from the room; a viewer who is kicked can come back, but with their chat already restricted.
howto.host_t3_text: Tools that help you talk with the class during the lesson.
howto.host_t3_1_text: In the chat, @name or !user(name) mentions someone, and !code(line, file) quotes a line. Clicking a quote takes the person straight to that line of the file.
howto.spectator_t1_text: To watch, you need the room code, which the Host gives to the class.
howto.spectator_t1_1_text: On the home screen, click Viewer, enter your name and the room code.
howto.spectator_t1_2_text: If the Host sent you a link, just open it: the code is already filled in and you only enter your name.
howto.spectator_t2_text: You follow the Host's screen and code in real time, and can move around them freely without bothering anyone.
howto.spectator_t2_1_text: The Host's screen appears on the left. With the mouse over it, use Fullscreen or Hide screen (to see only the code). Drag the divider between the panels to resize them.
howto.spectator_t2_2_text: Each tab is a file the Host has open; click to switch. The line the Host is on is highlighted, and Follow the Host follows their tab and line automatically. Scroll the code freely and use the header buttons to copy or download the current file.
howto.spectator_t3_text: Tools to take part in the lesson and deal with the unexpected.
howto.spectator_t3_1_text: In the chat, @name or !user(name) mentions someone. To quote a line, use !code(line, file) or select a piece of code and click Quote line. Click a quote in the chat to jump straight to that line.
howto.spectator_t3_2_title: If the Host restricts your chat
howto.spectator_t3_2_text: You can still see everything and copy and download the code, but you can't send messages, mentions or quotes until the Host allows it again.
howto.spectator_t3_3_text: The site tries to reconnect on its own. If it's the Host who drops, you see a waiting notice and the room only closes if they don't come back in time.
